mapper.sql: id, old_master_id, new_master_id, switch_time, switch_type, switch_result, created_time, updated_time
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS "eventId", e.old_master_id AS "oldMasterId", e.new_master_id AS "newMasterId", e.switch_time AS "switchTime", e.switch_type AS "switchType", e.switch_result AS "switchResult", o.instance_name AS "oldInstanceName", n.instance_name AS "newInstanceName" FROM redis_switch_event e LEFT JOIN redis_instance o ON e.old_master_id = o.instance_id LEFT JOIN redis_instance n ON e.new_master_id = n.instance_id WHERE e.switch_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND e.switch_type != '0' ORDER BY e.switch_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
